historical_references.reference: Mithunkumar was a famous Jain monk and scholar in the 11th century. He is known for his significant contributions to the Jain literature, particularly in the field of Jain grammar and logic.
historical_references.context: Mithunkumar was a prominent figure in the Jain intellectual tradition during the medieval period in India.

historical_references.reference: Mithunkumar is also mentioned in the 15th century Jain text known as 'Syadvadin Khandagama'. In this text, he is described as a renowned Jain scholar and a guru of the Digambara sect.
historical_references.context: Mithunkumar continued to be revered as a respected scholar and teacher in the Jain community even centuries after his death.
